spine: 1. RSA/ECC 是我們用了幾十年的簽章演算法，一旦「夠強大的量子電腦」出現就會被破解；ML-DSA 是 NIST 在 2024 年標準化的第一個用來取代它們的後量子簽章。
2. ML-DSA-44 的公鑰 1,312 bytes、簽章 2,420 bytes，比 Ed25519 的 32/64 bytes 大了一到兩個數量級——這個體積差直接衝擊憑證鏈、handshake 這些對 bytes 敏感的場景。
3. Cloudflare 的立場是「不能再等」：NIST 三輪 on-ramp 篩出的九個候選方案，依照類別分別要到 2030（proof-of-knowledge）、2031/2034（multivariate 標準/普及）、2033（FN-DSA 普及）、2035（SQIsign 普及）才可能成熟，而 Cloudflare 自己的目標是 2029 年前完成後量子化。
4. 遷移期一定要同時支援古典與後量子簽章，而雙軌並存本身就打開 downgrade attack 的門——唯一乾淨的解法是關掉古典演算法，但在 WebPKI 這種分散式系統裡短期做不到。Rescorla 的話被引用來說明這個處境：「You go to war with the algorithms you have, not the ones you wish you had.」

5. 九個候選各有各的取捨，沒有一個同時做到小、快、穩：SQIsign 簽章小（148 bytes）但簽章慢 300 倍、驗證慢 50 倍，還難防 timing side-channel；UOV 簽章只要 96 bytes，但公鑰暴增到 66,576 bytes；FN-DSA 簽章相對小，但天生要靠浮點運算實作，是密碼標準史上第一次；HAWK 引入全新的 lattice isomorphism problem 假設，2024 年被發現在特例上可解（雖然那個特例不影響 HAWK 本身用的參數）；SLH-DSA 無狀態、設計保守，代價是簽章 7,856～17,088 bytes、驗證慢 40～110 倍；MAYO（454 bytes 簽章）目前沒被找到針對其結構的攻擊，SNOVA（248 bytes 簽章）體積最省，卻一直因為被攻破而改結構。
6. 結論務實而不浪漫：不是每個系統都撐得住 ML-DSA 的體積代價，也不是每個系統都能等到更好的簽章方案成熟——有人得先接受效能代價把 ML-DSA 部署上去，有人得靠限制存取、把流量包進 tunnel、加強監控來撐過這段安全落差。

perspective.mechanism: 解釋後量子簽章為什麼「大又慢」是結構性的（格密碼、同源、多變量、雜湊式各家族的數學基礎決定了體積/速度的取捨曲線），以及 NIST on-ramp 三輪篩選機制如何逐步淘汰候選方案。
perspective.tradeoff: 核心 tradeoff 是「現在部署效能較差但成熟的 ML-DSA」vs.「等待效能更好但要到 2030 年代才可能成熟的候選方案」——而等待本身因為必須維持雙軌相容而製造 downgrade attack 風險，所以等待不是免費的中立選項。
perspective.reader_use: 工程師讀完後知道：規劃憑證鏈、TLS handshake、簽章驗證吞吐量時，要把 ML-DSA 的體積代價（比 Ed25519 大一到兩個數量級）當成近期必須吸收的成本來抓 capacity；同時知道「等更好的方案」在系統夠大時不是安全選項，因為雙軌並存的遷移期本身就是攻擊面。

notes.quote: ML-DSA 44 | ✅ | 1,312 | 2,420 | 1 (baseline) | 1 (baseline)
notes.interpretation: 文章比較表中 ML-DSA-44 這一列：公鑰 1,312 bytes、簽章 2,420 bytes，速度設為對照組基準值 1。
同一張表中 Ed25519 這一列：公鑰 32 bytes、簽章 64 bytes，簽署比 ML-DSA-44 快（0.15 倍時間即完成），驗證比 ML-DSA-44 略慢（1.3 倍時間）。

notes.quote: They were standardized in 2024 by the U.S. National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)
notes.interpretation: ML-DSA（連同 SLH-DSA）在 2024 年由 NIST 正式標準化，是後量子簽章第一批拍板的演算法。

notes.quote: As Eric Rescorla wrote in 2024: You go to war with the algorithms you have, not the ones you wish you had.
notes.interpretation: 文章引用 Eric Rescorla 2024 年的說法，用來支持「不能等更完美的方案，現在能用的就是 ML-DSA」這個核心論點。

notes.quote: We are targeting 2029 for Cloudflare to be fully post-quantum secure.
notes.interpretation: Cloudflare 自陳的內部目標是 2029 年前完成全面後量子化，用「targeting」而非「will」，是目標而非承諾期限。

notes.quote: last month, NIST announced that it is advancing nine post-quantum signature schemes to the third round of the "signatures on-ramp".
notes.interpretation: NIST 的 on-ramp 篩選進入第三輪，共有九個候選方案存活到這一輪。

notes.quote: If the FN-DSA draft is released today, and it progresses at the same rate as ML-DSA, then we'd perhaps have some early software support in early 2029, but no significant deployment. We would not expect FN-DSA to be widely available before 2033.
notes.interpretation: 以 ML-DSA 的標準化速度做類比推算，FN-DSA（Falcon 的標準化版本）2029 年頂多有早期軟體支援，要到 2033 年才可能廣泛可用。

notes.quote: we might see a multivariate NIST standard in 2031, and wider product availability not earlier than 2034.
notes.interpretation: 多變量密碼（MAYO/SNOVA 這類）樂觀推算 2031 年可能成為 NIST 標準，2034 年前不會有廣泛的產品可用性。

notes.quote: wide availability before 2035 seems unlikely.
notes.interpretation: 文章對 SQIsign（同源密碼）的推算：2035 年之前不太可能廣泛可用。

notes.quote: we wouldn't expect product availability before 2034.
notes.interpretation: 文章對 HAWK 的推算：產品可用性不會早於 2034 年。

notes.quote: a proof of knowledge algorithm will be the first new NIST standard to see the light in 2030.
notes.interpretation: 如果目前的篩選節奏維持穩定，proof-of-knowledge 類別（如 MQOM、SDitH）會是九個候選裡最早在 2030 年成為新 NIST 標準的一類。

notes.quote: In a system of any reasonable size, you can't upgrade everything all at once. You'll need a transition period where both post-quantum and traditional signatures are supported. And supporting both allows for a downgrade attack. The most straightforward way to prevent such downgrades is to disable classical cryptography.
notes.interpretation: 任何有規模的系統都無法一次全部升級完，遷移期必須同時支援古典與後量子簽章；而雙軌支援本身就打開 downgrade attack 的空間，唯一乾淨的防堵法是關掉古典演算法。

notes.quote: RSA and ECC, cryptographic algorithms that we've all relied on for decades, are vulnerable to the attack of sufficiently advanced quantum computers.
notes.interpretation: 文章開場論點：RSA 與 ECC 這兩個用了幾十年的簽章演算法，會被「夠強大的量子電腦」攻破。

notes.quote: Despite great signatures and more advanced cryptography on the horizon, we should not forget the task at hand: staying secure in the immediate future.
notes.interpretation: 文章結論：即使未來有更好的簽章方案在地平線上，眼前的任務仍是在近期內維持安全——也就是先用 ML-DSA 頂上去。
文章完整比較表的其餘各列，欄位依序為：演算法、是否後量子、公鑰 bytes、簽章 bytes、簽署相對速度（以 ML-DSA-44=1 為基準，數字越大越慢）、驗證相對速度（同基準，數字越大越慢）。這是本篇 hero 圖表 data-driven-chart 的資料來源。

notes.quote: stateful hash-based signature schemes are built out of one-time-signature keys which are collected into Merkle trees. The signer has to keep track of which one-time-signature keys have been used.
notes.interpretation: 有狀態的雜湊式簽章方案（早期方案）用一次性簽章金鑰組成 Merkle tree，簽署方必須追蹤哪些金鑰已經用過；SLH-DSA 的賣點正是「無狀態」，不必追蹤這件事。

notes.quote: A huge public key: 66kB. That wouldn't help for a TLS server certificate, whose public key is transmitted over the wire when setting up a connection.
notes.interpretation: UOV 簽章雖小，但公鑰高達 66kB，這對需要在連線時把公鑰傳過網路的 TLS 伺服器憑證來說沒有幫助。

notes.quote: So far no attacks on the whipping structure, and thus on MAYO specifically, have been found.
notes.interpretation: MAYO 使用的「whipping」結構目前為止沒有被找到專門針對它的攻擊——「so far」保留了未來可能被攻破的空間。

notes.quote: continuously changed the actual structure. Every time, they take the leap forward and propose a new SNOVA with even better performance.
notes.interpretation: SNOVA 團隊在遭遇攻擊後多次更換底層結構，每次都順勢推出效能更好的新版本——體積最省，但穩定性一直在動。

notes.quote: is most naturally and efficiently implemented using hardware-accelerated floating-point arithmetic. This is a first for a cryptographic standard.
notes.interpretation: FN-DSA（Falcon）天生最適合用硬體加速的浮點運算實作，這是密碼標準史上頭一次要靠浮點運算，讓側通道防護變得困難。

notes.quote: HAWK is based on and introduces a new security assumption, the lattice isomorphism problem (LIP). In 2024, two years after the introduction of HAWK, it was discovered that this problem is easy to solve in the special case of totally real number fields, which aren't used in HAWK or any other cryptography.
notes.interpretation: HAWK 建立在一個全新的困難假設 LIP 上；2024 年有人證明 LIP 在「totally real number fields」這個特例下容易求解，但這個特例不是 HAWK 實際使用的參數——所以尚未直接打中 HAWK，卻凸顯這個年輕假設的安全邊界還在被摸索。

notes.quote: it's difficult to implement signature creation in a timing side-channel secure way and doing so comes with a performance penalty to boot.
notes.interpretation: SQIsign 的簽署過程很難用抵抗 timing side-channel 的方式實作，而且做到這件事本身還要再付出效能代價。

notes.quote: Lattices, Symmetric (hash-based), Isogeny, Proof of knowledge, and Multivariate
notes.interpretation: 文章把後量子簽章分成五個數學家族：格密碼、對稱／雜湊式、同源、零知識證明系統、多變量。九個 on-ramp 候選散布在這五個家族裡。

notes.quote: Some will have to accept a performance cost. Others will need to deal with the security gap in other ways, such as restricting access, tunneling, more monitoring, or a myriad of other measures that are costly on their own.
notes.interpretation: 文章對「等不起也上不動」系統給的務實建議：有些系統得先接受效能代價部署 ML-DSA，有些系統得靠限制存取、tunnel、加強監控撐過安全落差——這些補救手段本身也要付出成本，不是免費的替代方案。

claims.evidence: "Some will have to accept a performance cost. Others will need to deal with the security gap in other ways, such as restricting access, tunneling, more monitoring, or a myriad of other measures that are costly on their own." — confirmed verbatim.

claims.claim_text: 早期的有狀態雜湊式簽章…用一次性簽章金鑰組成 Merkle tree，簽署方必須自己追蹤哪些金鑰已經用過
claims.location: under H2「九個候選」/ SLH-DSA 段
claims.evidence: "stateful hash-based signature schemes are built out of one-time-signature keys which are collected into Merkle trees. The signer has to keep track of which one-time-signature keys have been used." — confirmed verbatim.
